headline: Both producers' callers are found and the five axes have the game's own names. The bot's caller is 0099ACD0 (PilotBot vtable +0Ch) at call site 0099B0A0; the player's is 00519BB0 (pilot HUD screen vtable 00CEC578+38h) at call site 00519CF7. 007D5D20 reads the control block out of the unit's Lua property bag field by field, and the key string that follows each field pointer names it: +9E4h yawInput, +9E8h pitchInput, +9ECh rollInput, +9F0h pwrInput, +9F4h airBrakeInput, +9F9h turboInput, +9FAh gunFire.

corrections.was: unit+9E4h is roll, unit+9ECh is yaw, and unit+9F4h is an unnamed fifth axis
corrections.is: unit+9E4h is yawInput, unit+9ECh is rollInput, and unit+9F4h is airBrakeInput
corrections.evidence: 007D5D20 reads each field through BSP_LuaReader_ReadField(reader, 0, key, 2, &field), pushing {2,&field} then {0,key}: 007D69BA/007D69D6 pairs unit+9E4h with 00D05D94 'yawInput', 007D69F1/007D6A0D pairs unit+9ECh with 00D05D88 'rollInput', 007D6A5F/007D6A7B pairs unit+9F4h with 00D05D6C 'airBrakeInput'. The dynamics group names the latched copies the same way (unit+BB0h yawF, unit+BB8h rollF, unit+BC0h airBrakeF), matching the latch 007B9770's permutation. 0099BC00 clamps only the +9F0h and +9F4h commands to [0,1].

corrections.was: the rate law's yaw term is classDesc+1B0h YawSpd times the latched roll unit+0BB0h
corrections.is: unit+BB0h is yawF, the latched yawInput, so the term is YawSpd times the latched yaw; the two readings docs/PILOT_CONTROLS.md called contradictory agree once the labels are fixed, because unit+9ECh carrying the horizontal aim error is a bank-to-turn roll command
corrections.evidence: 007D6BB2 pairs unit+BB0h with 00D05D30 'yawF'; 007B9770 copies unit+9E4h to unit+BB0h

corrections.was: 0099BEE0's out record is the 0x84-byte block 007C2810 allocates, and the bot's axes reach unit+9E4h over the session message path (marked a hypothesis)
corrections.is: out is a six-dword stack buffer in 0099ACD0 at [ESP+10h], handed straight to 007B8C90 at 0099B0B9. The 0x84 record is the 0C1h session-message payload cached at owner+0Ch; its first six dwords only share the control block's default (0,0,0,1.0f,0,0)

run_time_evidence: none taken. The two producers are reached only with a live mission and a plane the local player pilots, which bsp_game.exe does not reach (docs/GAME_EXECUTABLE.md); every claim here is static.
tool_problems: ghidra xrefs under-reports: 0099BEE0, 00519520, 0099ACD0, 007C2880 and 007D5D20 all had callers or vtable slots it did not list. Every caller in this report came from scanning the disk image for E8/E9 rel32 targets and for four-byte little-endian addresses.

bsp.py show --asm resolves exports under the main checkout's exports/bsp, so the listing files are at J:/PROG/battlestations-pacific-decompile/exports/bsp/functions/<addr>/assembly.txt and not under the worktree; Get-ChildItem on the worktree path fails.
PowerShell in this environment has no rg; Select-String or the Grep tool is needed instead.

tools/verify_report_calls.py requires a call site to lie inside a Ghidra function, so the twelve call sites inside undisassembled code are listed under undisassembled_call_sites with site/callee keys rather than address/native; the tool structurally cannot check them and Ghidra is read-only for this packet.
